title: Spec Approval Record
description: Written to .sapkit/program/{PROG}/approval.json at the Spec Approval Gate of create-program. Binds the human approval to the exact spec content (SHA-256 of spec.md) and to the target SAP system, so that a spec edit or a system switch after approval invalidates the approval.

spec_sha256.description: SHA-256 (lowercase hex) of spec.md exactly as approved. Phase 4 and Phase 6 recompute and compare; mismatch requires re-approval.

sid.description: SAP system ID the approval applies to (from the active connection profile). On create-program's abapGit delivery branch there is no active connection profile — nothing is connected at any point — so this comes from the user's own declaration of the system the ZIP is destined for, recorded as their affirmation rather than as a read of a live session.

client.description: SAP client the approval applies to. On the abapGit delivery branch it likewise comes from the user's declaration rather than an active connection profile.

tier.description: System tier from the connection profile (e.g. sandbox, dev, qa, prd). On the abapGit delivery branch this records the user's explicit DEV-tier affirmation instead: nothing is connected, so the server-side tier gate cannot fire and the affirmation is what stands in its place — a procedural norm, not a machine check.

transport.description: Transport request the approved work will be recorded on (from Phase 1B dimension 6). On the abapGit delivery branch this is a user-owned marker, not a request the agent created or will write to: the transport is decided by the user at abapGit pull time on their own system, so what is recorded here is the transport they intend to use.

approval_keyword.description: The exact explicit approval keyword the user typed. Only these keywords count as approval.

prog.description: Program name the spec covers (optional convenience field).

approver.description: Identifier of the approving user, when known (optional).
